title: Poolside Argument
description: Two large women stand in a swimming pool at night, arguing. The pale-skinned woman with a crown and 'I AM THAT GIRL' written on her chest jumps angrily while pointing, facing a dark-skinned woman in a purple swimsuit with 'NO YOU AIN'T' on her chest who gestures back.
prompt: Two plus-size women arguing in a swimming pool at dusk, the pale woman with a crown and 'I AM THAT GIRL' written across her chest is jumping and pointing aggressively, the dark-skinned woman in a purple one-piece swimsuit has 'NO YOU AIN'T' written on her chest and points back, both standing in turquoise water creating ripples, a purple unicorn pool float and pink flamingo float nearby, a diving board above, palm trees and a neon 'SPELLFORGE' sign in the background, dramatic cinematic lighting, detailed skin textures, vibrant colors
